slides.narration: Chapter 23: The Primordial Spectrum. The seeds of all cosmic structure — galaxies, clusters, the cosmic web — were planted in the first fraction of a second. The tower derives their statistical properties.

The spectral tilt — how the primordial ripples vary with scale — comes out to 53 over 55, matching the Planck satellite measurement to 0.3 standard deviations. The tensor-to-scalar ratio r equals D cubed — a prediction that upcoming experiments like CMB-S4 will test.
